'''Ryloth Place!''' was a [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] starring [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]]. It was transmitted during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The title might refer to the famous soap opera [[Wikipedia:Melrose Place|''Melrose Place'']].
